Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 3 on hand, on no return.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425717 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425717-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 3 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425717 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close.
  • Use a desktop browser that can open a second tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
  • Start in browser tab 1 on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
